name: Dining with Whiskers

start.dialog: BEHOLD! Mr. Whiskers needs SPECIAL desert lizards! For... dietary reasons! Bring me FIVE and I'll perform a PRIVATE show! Just for YOU! The spotted ones! From the dunes near the bazaar!
start.objective: Collect 5 spotted desert lizards from the dunes near the bazaar

progress.dialog: Those lizards! Mr. Whiskers is PECKISH! Well, snake-ish! Five spotted ones! He won't eat the plain ones - too BORING!
progress.objective: Continue searching the dunes for spotted desert lizards

complete.dialog: PERFECT lizards! Mr. Whiskers is PLEASED! See how his eyes sparkle! Or... don't see, because snakes don't have expressive faces! Here - a SNAKE CHARM! Real magic! Probably!

party_comments.twist: CAN I PET HIM?! PLEASE?! I'LL BE GENTLE!
party_comments.nix7: Scanning: Snake is... not poisonous? False advertising detected.

hidden_outcome: If you bring 10 lizards instead of 5, Mr. Whiskers becomes overstuffed and Sssilas gives you the 'Snake Charmer's Flute' instrument item
